summary: A Qatar developer with over 80 projects appears to lose serious buyers because template demo menu items and a default filter option are still on show.

findings.problem: The page menu appears to still carry the theme demo list: Default With Caption, Side Search With Map, Splash Slider, Typography and Page 404.
findings.cost: A buyer or investor who sees demo names on a developer's site starts to doubt how carefully the company runs a project worth millions.
findings.fix: A clean menu with only Buy, Rent, Projects and Contact.

findings.problem: The property search status filter appears to offer an Out of Stock option next to For Rent and For Sale.
findings.cost: A visitor who picks it finds nothing, and a search that returns nothing sends the buyer to a competitor.
findings.fix: A search filter that shows only options with real listings.

findings.problem: Different Retaj teams appear to use separate WhatsApp numbers for leasing, maintenance and sales, with no single lead form for new buyers on the homepage.
findings.cost: A new buyer does not know which number to message, and an unanswered message is a lost sale.
findings.fix: One clear enquiry path that sends each lead to the right team.

redesign: Search that shows real stock only.
One enquiry path to the right team.
